body: Two-part implementation: (1) emily-agent cron.go now includes tokens_used in cycle Apple metadata (sum of IterationRecord.TokensUsed across all task iterations this cycle) and body. (2) emily.cli TUI now has fetchTokenSpendFromIDUNA() — fetches today emily-source Apples, calls GetApple() for each to get metadata, extracts tokens_used, shows as 'emily-prime: N cycles, Mk tokens (IDUNA)' row in TOKEN BUDGET panel. iduna.Apple struct gains Metadata json.RawMessage field. emily-agent commit d5ffc92 + emily.cli commit d2c68d9.
title: emily tui: real token accounting from IDUNA Apple metadata
